title: OmicsGBench: A Framework for Evaluating Graph Neural Networks on Omics Data
abstract: arXiv:2605.15511v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become the dominant framework for inductive graph-level learning. Yet most benchmarks focus on the regime $n \gg p$, where the number of graphs $n$ greatly exceeds the number of nodes per graph $p$. This overlooks biological domains such as omics, which operate in the opposite $n \ll p$ regime, characterized by large graphs of genes, transcripts, or proteins across few patient samples. This raises the question: how do GNNs perform in this low-sample, high-node omics setting? We introduce OmicsGBench (Omics-Graph Bench), the first benchmarking platform for graph-level prediction on omics expression data, a domain whose defining characteristic is the $n \ll p$ regime. We provide a standardized, end-to-end modular infrastructure from raw omics data to families of featured graphs with varied structural properties. translated_title: OmicsGBench：一个用于在组学数据上评估图神经网络的框架
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）已成为归纳式图级学习的主流框架。然而，大多数基准测试都聚焦于 n ≫ p 的情形，即图的数量 n 远大于每个图的节点数 p。这忽视了诸如组学等生物领域，这些领域处于相反的 n ≪ p 情形，其特征是在少量患者样本上构建由基因、转录本或蛋白质组成的大型图。这就提出了一个问题：GNN 在这种低样本、高节点的组学环境中表现如何？我们推出了 OmicsGBench（Omics-Graph Bench），这是首个针对组学表达数据进行图级预测的基准测试平台，该领域的决定性特征正是 n ≪ p 的情形。我们提供了从原始组学数据到具有不同结构特性的特征图族的标准化、端到端模块化基础设施。我们对经典 GNN 以及为大型图和组学应用设计的 GNN 进行了基准测试。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对组学表达数据图级预测的基准测试平台 OmicsGBench，系统评估了图神经网络在低样本、高节点（n ≪ p）情形下的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OmicsGBench, the first benchmarking platform for graph-level prediction on omics expression data, systematically evaluating graph neural networks in the low-sample, high-node (n << p) regime.
